question: How many signals, bacteria and replicates made up the feature matrix for pattern recognition?

trace.query: SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%matrix%' OR text ILIKE '%replicat%' OR text ILIKE '%×%'
SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 20 AND 32

SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'\((\d+) signals',1) AS INT)*CAST(regexp_extract(a.text,'× (\d+)$',1) AS INT)*CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'×(\d+) replicates',1) AS INT) AS total FROM lines a, lines b WHERE a.id='p6.L26' AND b.id='p6.L27'
